notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.14 v1.0.4A
notes.content: [p]Good Sunday, Your Majesty. We have implemented some further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p]Bug fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]The effect of the "Celestial Mandate" event will now be removed upon entering Endless Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased clearance rewards on certain difficulty levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new low-difficulty mode, accessible via the leftmost button in the difficulty tab on the mode selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain sound effects.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]Happy weekend![/p]

tags.bug: The effect of the "Celestial Mandate" event will now be removed upon entering Endless Mode.

tags.balance_change: Slightly increased clearance rewards on certain difficulty levels.

tags.feature: Added a new low-difficulty mode, accessible via the leftmost button in the difficulty tab on the mode selection screen.

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.13 v1.03B
notes.content: [p]Good afternoon, Your Majesty. We have implemented further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p]Bug fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the numerical color of card corner icons—each stacking value now has a unique color indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of certain crisis challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the appearance rates of certain cards and policies—higher-quality cards and policies are now more likely to appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional sound effects.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]We hope you enjoy the game! You are also cordially invited to join our [url="https://discord.gg/HyRzbWvpxN"]Discord [/url]to discuss court affairs together![/p]

tags.bug: - Changed the numerical color of card corner icons—each stacking value now has a unique color indicator.

tags.balance_change: - Reduced the difficulty of certain crisis challenges.
- Adjusted the appearance rates of certain cards and policies—higher-quality cards and policies are now more likely to appear.
